Message:
As I staggered to my feet,
I heard someone’s voice
calling from beyond
the pile of boulders.

Okay, I’ll break you out of there,
so just hold on a little longer...!”

A warm light started to
wrap around me.
This is...Fortina’s light...

Her light must’ve cleansed
the poison from my body.
But...

“A promise is something
kept by two people.
That is why I came for you.

So you and I can keep it...
together.”

I was weighed down
by the guilt of breaking
my vow back then.

So much so,
I became fixated on
keeping my promise,
and lost sight of
what was truly important.

It’s true.
This promise isn’t mine alone.

It belongs to the two of us.
So, I told her...

“Thank you, Fortina.
Now, let’s get through this...
together...!”
